title: Physical therapist use of support or auxiliary personnel
bodyText:
. (a) A physical therapist may use support or auxiliary personnel, including licensed physical therapist assistants, to assist the physical therapist in the practice of physical therapy; provided that the support or auxiliary personnel shall:

(1) Perform only the duties prescribed in the rules of the board; and

(2) Perform these duties under the supervision and direction of a physical therapist.

(b) Physical therapists and physical therapist assistants shall provide proof of compliance with this section upon written request from the board.
bodyHtml:
[§461J-2.3]  Physical therapist use of support or auxiliary personnel.  (a)  A physical therapist may use support or auxiliary personnel, including licensed physical therapist assistants, to assist the physical therapist in the practice of physical therapy; provided that the support or auxiliary personnel shall:

     (1)  Perform only the duties prescribed in the rules of the board; and

     (2)  Perform these duties under the supervision and direction of a physical therapist.

     (b)  Physical therapists and physical therapist assistants shall provide proof of compliance with this section upon written request from the board.  [L 2013, c 220, pt of §1]
